name: QKI, KH domain containing RNA binding
pathways: regulation of mRNA splicing, via spliceosome

function.text: QKI encodes KH domain-containing RNA-binding protein QKI. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coactivator activity and internal N(7)-methylguanine-containing RNA reader activity. It participates in regulation of mRNA splicing, via spliceosome and mRNA stabilization.

germline.text: The reviewed GenCC assertions do not establish a conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship for this draft; limited or conflicting assertions require separate review.

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Glioblastoma Multiforme; Melanoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.
